verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents recurring cron schedules for sandbox commands, plus one-off future-datetime and delayed runs with per-run execution history (blaxel-docs-26). Batch jobs for AI workflows can also run as scheduled or on-demand serverless jobs (blaxel-docs-35), and agents can drive job creation through the Blaxel skill (blaxel-docs-15). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed docs on job-level schedule configuration (cron syntax, retries, failure handling).
